exposure: early screen exposure (daily screen time > 6h before age two, interactive engagement, first continuous exposure at ages 2-3 years vs after age 3)
early antibiotic exposure (2-3 courses before age 2, 3-6 courses before age 2)
cohort: The study included 52 children with ASD (cases) and 101 neurotypical controls, all aged 2-12 years, recruited from Kasr Al-Ainy Psychiatry Hospital and the surrounding community in Egypt.
finding: Early non-interactive screen exposure, specific patterns of antibiotic use, male sex, older paternal age, and maternal psychiatric disorders during pregnancy were associated with higher odds of ASD.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery and delivery complications were not associated with higher ASD odds.
